G4000.def:
πεντακισ-χίλιοι, -αι, -α 
five thousand: Matthieu 14:21 16:9, Marc 6:44 8:19, Luc 9:14, Jean 6:10.†

G4002.def:
πέντε 
indecl., οἱ, αἱ, τά, 
five: Matthieu 14:17, al

G4004.def:
πεντήκοντα 
indecl., οἱ, αἱ, τά, 
fifty: Luc 7:41 16:6, Jean 8:57 21:11, Actes 13:20; ἀνὰ π., Luc 9:14; κατὰ π., Marc 6:40.†

G4006.def:
πεποίθησις, -εως, ἡ
(πείθω), [in LXX: 4Ki.18:19 (בִּטָּחוֹן)* ;] 
confidence: 2 Corinthiens 1:15 3:4 10:2, Éphésiens 3:12; before εἰς, 2 Corinthiens 8:22; ἐν, Philippiens 3:4 (the word is condemned by the Atticists, see Rutherford, NPhr., 355).†

G4010.def:
Πέργαμος, -ου, ἡ
(so Xen., Paus., al., but -ον, τό in Strabo, Polyb., and most writers, also in Inscr.; in NT the termination is uncertain) 
Pergamum, a city of Mysia: Apocalypse 1:11 2:12.†

G4011.def:
Πέργη, -ης, ἡ 
Perga, a city of Pamphylia: Actes 13:13-14 14:25.†

G4012.def:
περί, 
prep. with genitive, accusative (in cl. also with dative; cf. M, Pr., 105f.), 
with radical sense round about (as distinct from ἀμφί, on both sides). 
__I. C. genitive, 
__1. of place, about (poët.). 
__2. Causal, about, on account of, concerning, in reference to: Matthieu 2:8, Marc 1:44, Luc 4:38, Jean 16:26, Actes 28:21, al. mult.; τὰ περί, with genitive, the things concerning one, one's state or case: Marc 5:27, Actes 1:3 28:15, Éphésiens 6:22, al.; at the beginning of a sentence, περί, regarding, as to, 1 Corinthiens 7:1, al.; in the sense on account of (Matthieu 26:28, 1 Corinthiens 1:13, al.), often with ὑπέρ as variant (cf. M, Pr., 105). 
__II. C. accusative, 
__1. of place, about, around: Matthieu 3:4, Marc 1:6, Luc 13:8, Actes 22:6, al.; οἱ περί, with accusative of person(s), of one's associates, friends, etc., Marc 4:10, Luc 22:49, Jean 11:19, Actes 13:13; οἱ περὶ τ. τοιαῦτα ἐργάται, Actes 19:25; metaphorically, about, as to, concerning: 1 Timothée 1:19 6:4 2 Timothée 2:18 3:8, Tite 2:7; τὰ περὶ ἐμέ, Philippiens 2:23; αἱ περὶ τ. λοιπὰ ἐπιθυμίαι, Marc 4:19. 
__2. Of time, in a loose reckoning, about, near: Matthieu 20:3, 5 6, 9 27:46, Marc 6:48, Actes 10:3, 9 22:6. 
__III. In composition: round about (περιβάλλω, περίκειμαι), beyond, over and above (περιποιέω, περιλείπω), to excess (περιεργάζομαι, περισσεύω).

G4013.def:
περι-άγω 
[in LXX: Amos 2:10 (הָלַךְ hi.); Ésaïe 28:27, Eze.47:2 (סָבַב hi., ho.); Eze.37:2 46:21 (עָבַר hi), 2Ma.4:38 2Mac 6:10 * ;] 
__1. to lead about or around: with accusative of person(s), 1 Corinthiens 9:5. 
__2. Intrans., to go about: Actes 13:11; before ἐν, Matthieu 4:23; with accusative loc. (governed by the περι-, not so in cl., see Bl., § 34, 1; 53, 1), Matthieu 9:35 23:15, Marc 6:6.†

G4014.def:
περι-αιρέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for סוּר hi. ;] 
to take away that which surrounds, take away, take off (τείχη, Hdt., Thuc.; χιτῶνα, Plat.; δακτύλιον, Genèse 41:42, cf. σφρηγῖδα, Hdt., ii, 151) : τ. κάλυΜΜα, pass., 2 Corinthiens 3:16; as nautical term (RV, cast off), ἀγκύρας, Actes 27:40; absol., to cast loose: Actes 28:13. Metaphorical, to take away entirely: ἐλπίς, pass., Actes 27:20; ἁμαρτίας, Hébreux 10:11.†

G4015.def:
περι-αστράπτω 
[in LXX: 4Ma.4:10 * ;] 
to flash around: with accusative, Actes 9:3; before περί Actes 22:6 (Eccl, and Byzant.).†

G4017.def:
περι-βλέπω 
[in LXX for שׁוּר, etc. ;] 
to look around (at). Mid., to look about one (at) : absol., Marc 9:8 10:23; with inf., Marc 5:32; with accusative of person(s), Marc 3:5, 34, Luc 6:10; πάντα, Marc 11:11.†

G4018.def:
περι-βόλαιον, -ου, τό
(περιβάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for כְּסוּת, לְבוּשׁ and cognate forms ;] 
that which is thrown around, a covering, in NT, 
__(a) a mantle (Psaumes 102:27, Ésaïe 59:17, al.) : Hébreux 1:12" (LXX) 
__(b) a veil: 1 Corinthiens 11:15 (but see ICC, in l).†

G4019.def:
περι-δέω 
[in LXX: Job 12:18 (אָסַר)* ;] 
to tie round, bind round: with accusative and dative, pass., Jean 11:44.†

G4020.def:
περι-εργάζομαι 
[in LXX: Wis.8:5 א1, Sir.3:23 * ;] 
__1. to waste one's labour about a thing. 
__2. to be a busybody: 2 Thessaloniciens 3:11 (cf. Plat., Apol., 19 B).†

G4021.def:
περίεργος, -ον 
__I. of persons; 
__1. over careful. 
__2. curious, meddling, a busybody: 1 Timothée 5:13. 
__II. Of things; 
__1. over-wrought. 
__2. super­fluous. 
__3. curious, uncanny; τὰ π., curious arts, magic: Actes 19:19 (see Deiss., BS, 3235.).†

G4022.def:
περι-έρχομαι 
[in LXX chiefly for סָבַב ;] 
to go about (as an itinerant): Actes 19:13 28:13 (περιελόντες, WH, R, mg.), Hébreux 11:37; τ. οἰκίας, from house to house: 1 Timothée 5:13.†

G4023.def:
περι-έχω, 
[in LXX for H661, H5362 hi., H6822 pi., etc. ;] 
__1. to surround, encompass: Luc 5:9 (cf. MM, xix). 
__2. to comprehend, include, contain, esp. of books: with accusative, Actes 23:25, Rec.; accusative to a late usage, intrans. (BL, § 53, 1.3; MM, xix; Hort, in l), it stands written, 1 Pierre 2:6.†

G4024.def:
περι-ζώννυμι and -ύω
(see Veitch, see word), [in LXX chiefly for חָגַר, also for אָזַר, etc. ;] 
to gird (with dupl, accusative, as ὁ περιζωννύων με δύναμιν, Psaumes 18:32): pass., αἱ ὀσφύες περιεζωσμέναι, Luc 12:35; π. ζώνην χρυσῆν, Apocalypse 1:13 15:6 (but see infr.). Mid., to gird oneself: Luc 12:37 17:8 (and so perh. Re, ll. with supr., cf. 1 Rois 2:4); with accusative of thing(s) (figuratively), τ. ὀσφύν, Éphésiens 6:14 (before ἐν, cf. 1 Chroniques 15:27).†

G4025.def:
περί-θεσις, -εως, ἡ
(περιτίθημι), [in Sm.: Psaumes 32:9 * ;] 
a putting around, putting on: 1 Pierre 3:3.†

G4026.def:
περι-ίστημι (Rec. ΐστημι) 
[in LXX: Josué 6:3 (סָבַב), 2 Rois 13:31 (נָצַב ni.), 1 Rois 4:16, Ep. Jérémie 37:1-21, Jdth.5:22, 2Ma.14:9 * ;] 
__1. to place around. 
__2. to stand around: Jean 11:42; with accusative of person(s), Actes 25:7. Mid. (in late writers), to turn oneself about to avoid, to shun: with accusative of thing(s), 2 Timothée 2:16, Tite 3:9.†

G4027.def:
περι-κάθαρμα, -τος, τό
(περικαθαίρω, to purify on all sides or completely, Deutéronome 18:10, Josué 5:4, 4Ma.1:29*), [in LXX: Proverbes 21:18 (כֹּפֶר)* ;] 
__1. a victim, expiation (Pr, l.with). 
__2. refuse, rubbish: pl., 1 Corinthiens 4:13 (see ICC, in l).†

G4028.def:
περι-καλύπτω 
[in LXX for כָּסָה pi., שָׁבַץ pu., etc. ;] 
to cover around, cover up or over. with accusative, Marc 14:65, Luc 22:64; pass., before χρυσίῳ, Hébreux 9:4.†

G4029.def:
περί-κειμαι 
[in LXX: Ep. Je 24, 58, 4Ma.12:3 * ;] 
__1. to lie round about: μύλος, λίθος (RV, were hanged about), Marc 9:42, Luc 17:2; νεφος μαρτύρων, Hébreux 12:1. 
__2. to have around one, be clothed with: Actes 28:20; figuratively, ἀσθένειαν, Hébreux 5:2.†

G4030.def:
περι-κεφαλαία, -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX for כּוֹבַע, קוֹבַע ;] 
a helmet: figuratively, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:8; with genitive explic., π. τ. σωτηρίου, Éphésiens 6:17 (cf. Ésaïe 59:17).†

G4031.def:
περι-κρατής, -ές 
[in LXX: Da TH Sus 1:39 A * ;] 
having full command of: Actes 27:16.†

G4032.def:
περι-κρύπτω 
to conceal entirely, keep hidden: late 2 aor., περιέκρυβσν (but see BL, § 17; Soph., Lex., see word περικρύβω), Luc 1:24.†

G4033.def:
περι-κυκλόω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for סָבַב ;] 
to encircle, encompass: of a besieged city, Luc 19:43.†

G4034.def:
περι-λάμπω 
to shine around: with accusative, Luc 2:9, Actes 26:13.†

G4035.def:
περι-λείπομαι depon. mid, and pass., 
[in LXX: 2 Chroniques 34:21 A (שָׁאַר ni.), 2Ma.1:31 2Mac 8:14, 4Ma.12:6 4Mac 13:18 * ;] 
to be left remaining, remain over, survive: 1 Thessaloniciens 4:15 4:17†

G4036.def:
περί-λυπος, -ον 
[in LXX: Psaumes 42:5, 11, I Esther 8:69, al. ;] 
very sad, deeply grieved: Matthieu 26:38, Marc 6:26 14:34, Luc 18:23.†

G4037.def:
περι-μένω 
[in LXX: Genèse 49:18 (קָוָה pi.), Wis.8:12 * ;] 
to wait for: with acce., Actes 1:4.†

G4038.def:
πέριξ 
adv., [in Al.: Lévitique 13:33 * ;] 
round about: αἱ π. πολεῖς, Actes 5:16.†

G4039.def:
περι-οικέω, -ῶ 
to dwell round about: with accusative, Luc 1:65.†

G4040.def:
περί-οικος, -ον 
[in LXX for כִּכָּר, etc. ;] 
dwelling around; as subst., ὁ π., a neighbour: Luc 1:58 (cf. πλησίον).†

G4041.def:
περιούσιος, -ον
(περίειμι, to be over and above), [in LXX: Exode 19:5 23:22, Deutéronome 7:6 14:2 26:18 (סְגֻלָּה, עַם)* ;] 
one's own, of one's own possession: λαὸς π. (cf. LXX, ll. with), Tite 2:14.†

G4042.def:
περι-οχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(περιέχω), [in LXX for מָצוּד, מָצוֹר, etc. ;] 
__1. compass, circumference. 
__2. a portion circumscribed, a section: Actes 8:32.†

G4043.def:
περι-πατέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ pi., hith. ;] 
to walk: absol., Matthieu 9:5, Marc 5:42, Luc 5:23, Jean 1:36; with pred., γυμνός, Apocalypse 16:15; ἐπάνω Luc 11:44; διά, with genitive, Apocalypse 21:24; ἐν, Marc 11:27 12:38, Jean 7:1 11:54, Apocalypse 2:1, al.; ἐν τ. σκοτίᾳ, figuratively, Jean 8:12 12:35, 1 Jean 1:6-7 Jn 2:11; ἐπί, with genitive, Matthieu 14:26; id. with dative, Matthieu 14:25, 29; μετά, Jean 6:66, Apocalypse 3:4; παρά, with accusative, Matthieu 4:18. Metaphorical, of living, passing one's life, conducting oneself (like ἀναστρέφομαι in Xen., Plut., LXX, π.; M, Proverbes 11:1-31; Deiss., BS, 194) : ἀκριβῶς, Éphésiens 5:15; ἀτάκτως, 2 Thessaloniciens 3:6 3:11; εὐσχημόνως, Apocalypse 13:13, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:12; ἀξίως, with genitive, Éphésiens 4:1, Colossiens 1:10, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:12; καθώς (ὥς), Éphésiens 4:17 5:8, 15, Philippiens 3:17, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:1; οὕτως ὥς, 1 Corinthiens 7:17; before nom. qual., Philippiens 3:18; with dative, Actes 21:21, Romains 13:13, 2 Corinthiens 12:18, Galates 5:16; before ἐν, Romains 6:4, 2 Corinthiens 4:2 5:7 10:3, Éphésiens 2:2, 10 4:17 5:2, Colossiens 3:7 4:5, Hébreux 13:9, 2Jn.4 Jn 6, al.; ἐν Χριστῷ, Colossiens 2:6; κατά, with accusative, Marc 7:5, Romains 8:4 14:15, 1 Corinthiens 3:3, 2 Corinthiens 10:2, 2Jn.6 (cf. ἐν-περιπατέω).

G4044.def:
περι-πείρω 
to put on a spit, hence, to pierce: metaphorically, ἑαυτὸν . . . ὀδύναις, 1 Timothée 6:10.†

G4045.def:
περι-πίπτω 
[in LXX: Ruth 2:3, 2 Rois 1:6 (קָרָה), Proverbes 11:5 (נָפַל), Dan LXX 2:9, 2Ma.6:13 2Mac 9:7 2Mac 9:21 2Mac 10:4 * ;] 
__1. to fall around. 
__2. to fall in with, light upon, come across: with dative, λῃσταῖς, Luc 10:30; πειρασμοῖς, Jacques 1:2; before εἰς, Actes 27:41.†

G4046.def:
περι-ποιέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for pi., hi., etc. ;] 
to make to remain over, preserve. 
Mid. 
__(a) to keep or save for oneself: τ. ψυχήν (cf. Xen., Cyr., iv, 4, 10; Arist., Pol., v, 11, 30), Luc 17:33; 
__(b) to get or gain for oneself, get possession of (Thuc., Xen., al.) : Actes 20:28, 1 Timothée 3:13.†

G4047.def:
περι-ποίησις, -εως, ἡ
(περιποιέω), [in LXX: 2 Chroniques 4:13 (12) (מִחְיָה) Malachie 3:17 (סְגֻלָּה), Aggée 2:10 (9) * ;] 
__1. preservation: Hébreux 10:39 (2 Ch, l.with). 
__2. acquisition, obtaining: 1 Thessaloniciens 5:9, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:14 (and so perh. Éphésiens 1:14, see infr.). 
__3. a possession: Éphésiens 1:14 (but see supr., and cf. ICC, in l), 1 Pierre 2:9 (LXX).†

G4048.def:
περι-ρήγνυμι
(Rec. -ρρ-, see supr.) [in LXX: 2Ma.4:38 * ;] 
to break or tear off all around: frequently of garments, τ. ἰμάτια, Actes 16:22.†

G4049.def:
περι-σπάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for עָנָה ;] 
to draw around, draw off or away. Metaphorical, to distract: pass., Luc 10:40.†

G4050.def:
περισσεία, -ας, ἡ
(περισσευω), [in LXX: Ecclésiaste 12:1-14 (יִתְרוֹן and cogn. forms, Ecclésiaste 1:3, al.) * ;] 
__1. abundance, superfluity: Romains 5:17, 2 Corinthiens 8:2 10:15, Jacques 1:21 (so also Inscr., see LAE, 80). 
__2. (a) superiority (Ec, see supr.); 
__(b) profit (ib.).†

G4051.def:
περίσσευμα, -τος, τό
(περισσεύω) [in LXX: Ecclésiaste 2:15 * ;] 
that which is over and above, superfluity, abundance: opposite to ὑστέρημα (which see), 2 Corinthiens 8:13-14; pl., Marc 8:8; metaphorically, π. τ. καρδίας, Matthieu 12:34, Luc 6:45 (cf. Ec, l.with; Plut., al.).†

G4052.def:
περισσεύω
(περισσός), [in LXX: 1 Rois 2:33 (מַרְבִּית), 1 Rois 2:36 Ecclésiaste 3:19 (יָתַר ni., יוׄתֵר), Tob.4:16, Sir.10:27 11:12 19:24, Sir 30:38 (Sir.33:29), 1Ma.3:30 * ;] 
__I. Prop., intrans., 
__1. of things, to be over and above the number (Hes.), hence, 
__(a) to be or remain over: Matthieu 14:20 15:37, Luc 9:17, Jean 6:12-13; 
__(b) to abound, be in abundance: Marc 12:44, Luc 12:15 21:4, Actes 16:5, Romains 3:7 5:15, 2 Corinthiens 1:5 8:2 9:12, Philippiens 1:26. 
__2. Of persons, 
__(a) to abound in, have in abundance: 1 Corinthiens 14:12 15:58, Philippiens 4:12, 18; with genitive, Luc 15:17 T; 
__(b) to be superior or better, to excel: absol., 1 Corinthiens 3:9 8:8; with dative ref., 2 Corinthiens 3:9; before ἐν, Romains 15:13, 1 Corinthiens 15:58, 2 Corinthiens 3:9 8:7, Colossiens 2:7; μᾶλλον, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:1 4:10; μ καὶ μ., Philippiens 1:9; πλεῖον, Matthieu 5:20. 
__II. In late writers (Lft., Notes, 48 f.), trans., 
__(a) to make to abound: with accusative before εἰς, 2 Corinthiens 4:15 9:8, Éphésiens 1:8; pass., Matthieu 13:12 25:29; with genitive of thing(s), Luc 15:17, WH; 
__(b) to make to excel: with accusative of person(s), dative of thing(s), 1 Thessaloniciens 3:12 (cf. ὑπερ-περισσεύω).†
SYN.: πλεονάζω

G4053.def:
περισσός, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX for יֶתֶר and cogn. forms ;] 
__1. more than sufficient, over and above, abundant: Jean 10:10, 2 Corinthiens 9:1; with genitive (a popular substitute for πλειών, Bl., § 11, 3.4), Matthieu 5:37; id. with ellips. genitive, Matthieu 5:47 (EV, more than others; but see infr.); εκ περισσοῦ, Marc 6:51, Rec., T. (on ὑπὲρ ὲκ π., see: ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ). Compar. neut., -ότερον: Luc 12:4, 48; with genitive, Marc 12:33; adverbially (cf. περισσῶς), more abund­antly, 2 Corinthiens 10:8, Hébreux 6:17 7:15; with genitive, π. πάντων, 1 Corinthiens 15:10; pleonast., μᾶλλον π., Marc 7:36. 
__2. out of the common, pre-eminent, superior: Matthieu 5:47 (Thayer, see word, but see supr.); τὸ π., as subst., Romains 3:1; compar., -ότερος, with genitive, Matthieu 11:9, Luc 7:26; with subst., Marc 12:40, Luc 20:47, 1 Corinthiens 12:23-24, 2 Corinthiens 2:7.†

G4054.def:
περισσότερον, -ως, see: περισσῶς.
περισσῶς
adv. (περισσός) [in LXX: Psaumes 31:23 (יֶתֶר -עַל), Da TH Daniel 7:7, 19 8:9 (יַתִּיר, יֶתֶר) 2Ma.8:27 2Mac 12:44 A * ;] 
beyond measure, exceedingly, abundantly: Matthieu 27:23, Marc 10:26 15:14, Actes 26:11. Compar. 
__(a) περισσότερον (see: περισσός); 
__(b) περισσοτέρως: 2 Corinthiens 1:12 2:4 7:15 11:23, Galates 1:14, Philippiens 1:14, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:17, Hébreux 2:1 13:19; π. μᾶλλον, 2 Corinthiens 7:13; opposite to ἧττον, 2 Corinthiens 12:15.†

G4055.def: more superabundant rabundant, excess, far fetched, superfluous (in number, degree or character)

G4056.def: to a greater degree; especially, frequently, extremely more, more abundantly, more earnestly, more vehemently, 2Cor. 7:13; exceedingly, extremely Gal. 1:14

G4057.def:
περισσῶς
adv. (περισσός) [in LXX: Psaumes 31:23 (יֶתֶר -עַל), Da TH Daniel 7:7, 19 8:9 (יַתִּיר, יֶתֶר) 2Ma.8:27 2Mac 12:44 A * ;] 
beyond measure, exceedingly, abundantly: Matthieu 27:23, Marc 10:26 15:14, Actes 26:11. Compar. 
__(a) περισσότερον (see: περισσός); 
__(b) περισσοτέρως: 2 Corinthiens 1:12 2:4 7:15 11:23, Galates 1:14, Philippiens 1:14, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:17, Hébreux 2:1 13:19; π. μᾶλλον, 2 Corinthiens 7:13; opposite to ἧττον, 2 Corinthiens 12:15.†

G4058.def:
περιστερά, -ᾶς, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for יוֹנָה ;] 
a dove: Matthieu 3:16 10:16 21:12, Marc 1:10 11:15, Luc 2:24 3:22, Jean 1:32 2:14, 16†

G4059.def:
περι-τέμνω 
[in LXX chiefly for מוּל ;] (Ion., Epic. and late writers), 
to cut around (Hdt.), hence, to circumcise (π. τὰ αἰδοῖα, Hdt.) : Luc 1:59 2:21, Jean 7:22, Actes 7:8 15:5 16:3 21:21. Pass. and mid., to be circumcised, receive circumcision: Actes 15:1, 1 Corinthiens 7:18, Galates 2:3 5:2-3 6:12-13 Metaphorical (cf. Deutéronome 10:16, Jérémie 4:4, al.), Colossiens 2:11 (see Deiss., BS, 151 f.; MM, xix).†

G4060.def:
περι-τίθημι 
[in LXX for נָתַן, שׂוּם, etc. ;] 
to place or put around: with accusative and dative, Matthieu 21:33 27:48, Marc 12:1 15:36, Jean 19:29; of garments, etc., to put on: Matthieu 27:28 Marc 15:17 (Sir.6:31). Metaphorical, like περιβάλλω, to bestow, confer (Thuc., al., Esther 1:20): 1 Corinthiens 12:23.†

G4062.def:
περι-τρέπω 
[in LXX: Wis.5:23 * ;] 
to turn about, turn: with accusative and, dative, Actes 26:24 (cf. FlJ, Ant., ix, 4, 4).†

G4063.def:
περι-τρέχω 
[in LXX: Amos 8:12, Jérémie 5:1 (שׁוּט pi.) * ;] 
to run about: with accusative loc., Marc 6:55.†

G4064.def:
περι-φέρω 
[in LXX: Ecclésiaste 7:8 (7) (הָלַל po.), al. ;] 
to carry about: Marc 6:55, 2 Corinthiens 4:10. Pass., metaphorically: Éphésiens 4:14.†

G4065.def:
περι-φρονέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: 4Ma.6:9 4Mac 14:1 * ;] 
__1. to examine on all sides, consider carefully (Aristoph.). 
__2. = ὑπερφρονέω, to have thouphts beyond, to despise (Thuc., Plut., al.; 4Mac, ll. with) : Tite 2:15.†

G4066.def:
περί-χωρος, -ον 
[in LXX: chiefly (ἡ π.) for כִּכָּר ;] 
round about, neighbouring (Dem., Plut., al.). In LXX and NT, as subst., ἡ π. (sc. γῆ), the region round about: Matthieu 14:35, Marc 1:28, Luc 4:14, 37 7:17 8:37, Actes 14:6; ἡ π. τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, Luc 3:3; by meton. for the people of the same region, Matthieu 3:5.†

G4067.def:
περί-ψημα, -τος, τό
(περιψράω, to wipe off all round), [in LXX: Tob.5:18 * ;] 
that which is wiped off, offscouring: metaphorically (assoc. with περικάθαρμα, which see), 1 Corinthiens 4:13 (and so prob., To, l.with, as EV; but see Thayer, see word, for the meaning expiation, ransom, in To; and cf. LS, see word κάθαρμα; Lft., Notes, 200 f., and on Ign., Eph., 8).†

G4068.def:
περπερεύοραι
(περπερος, vainglorious) 
to boast or vaunt oneself: 1 Corinthiens 13:4 (elsewhere. only in Antonin.; see Abbott, Essays, 87).†

G4069.def:
1. Persian , (Aeschulus Tragicus), etc. 
2. as Substantive, (.] (entry γῆ); Persis, Persia , now Farsistan , (Herdotus Historicus) 
3. (entry γυνή); a Persian woman , (Xenophon Historicus) 
4. (entry χλαῖνα); a Persian cloak , (Aristophanes Comicus) 
(ML)

G4070.def:
πέρυσι 
adv. (πέρας), 
last year, a year ago: ἀπὸ π. (as in π. see Deiss., BS, 221; LAE, 70), 2 Corinthiens 8:10 9:2.†

G4071.def:
πετεινός, -ή, -όν
(πέτομαι), [in LXX chiefly for עוֹף ;] 
in trag., Ion. and late writers, winged, flying; as subst., τὸ π., a winged fowl, a bird: pl., Matthieu 6:26 8:20 13:4, 32, Marc 4:4, 32, Luc 8:5 9:58 12:24 13:19, Actes 10:12 11:6, Romains 1:23, Jacques 3:7.†

G4072.def:
πέτομαι 
[in LXX chiefly for עוּף ;] 
to fly: Apocalypse 4:7 8:13 12:14 14:6 19:17 (Rec. πετάομαι, which see).†
πετάομαι, 
[in LXX: Deutéronome 4:17 * ;] 
false form of ποτάομαι, poët., frequentat. of πέτομαι (Aristoph., al.), Rec. for πέτομαι (which see, cf. Veitch, see word)

G4073.def:
πέτρα, -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for סֶלַע, צוּר ;] 
a rock, i.e. a mass of live rock as distinct from πέτρος, a detached stone or boulder : Matthieu 7:24-25 27:51, 60 Marc 15:46, Luc 6:48 8:6, 13; of a hollow rock, a cave, Apocalypse 6:15-16 (of. Ésaïe 2:10, al.). Metaphorical, Matthieu 16:18 (on the meaning, see Hort, Eccl., 16 ff., but cf. also ICC, in l), 1 Corinthiens 10:4; = πέτρος, Romains 9:33, 1 Pierre 2:8" (LXX) .†

G4074G.def:
Πέτρος, -ου, ὁ (i.e. a stone, see: πέτρα, Κηφᾶς), 
Simon Peter, the Apostle: Matthieu 4:18 10:2, Marc 3:16, Luc 5:8, Jean 1:41, 43, al.

G4075.def:
πετρώδης, -ες
(πέτρα, εἶδος), 
rock-like, rocky, stony: τὸ, τὰ π., of shallow soil with underlying rock, Matthieu 13:5, 20, Marc 4:5, 16.†

G4076.def:
πήγανον, -ου, τό 
περισσότερον, -ως, see: περισσῶς 
περισσῶς
adv. (περισσός) [in LXX: Psaumes 31:23 (יֶתֶר -עַל), Da TH Daniel 7:7, 19 8:9 (יַתִּיר, יֶתֶר) 2Ma.8:27 2Mac 12:44 A * ;] 
beyond measure, exceedingly, abundantly: Matthieu 27:23, Marc 10:26 15:14, Actes 26:11. Compar. 
__(a) περισσότερον (see: περισσός); 
__(b) περισσοτέρως: 2 Corinthiens 1:12 2:4 7:15 11:23, Galates 1:14, Philippiens 1:14, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:17, Hébreux 2:1 13:19; π. μᾶλλον, 2 Corinthiens 7:13; opposite to ἧττον, 2 Corinthiens 12:15.†

G4077.def:
πηγή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for עַיִן, also for מָקוֹר, etc. ;] 
a spring, fountain : Jacques 3:11, 2 Pierre 2:17; τ. δάτων, Apocalypse 8:10 14:7 16:4; of a well fed by a spring, Jean 4:6; π. τοῦ αἵματος, of a flow of blood, Marc 5:29; metaphorically, Jean 4:14, Apocalypse 7:17 21:6.†

G4078.def:
πήγνυμι 
[in LXX chiefly for נָטָה, also for תָּקַע, etc. ;] 
to make fast, to fix; of tents, to pitch: Hébreux 8:2 (cf. προσ-πήγνυμι).†

G4079.def:
πηδάλιον, -συ, τό
(πηδός, the blade of an oar), 
a rudder: Jacques 3:4; pl., Actes 27:40.†

G4080.def:
πηλίκος, -η, -ον 
[in LXX: Zacharie 2:2 (6) (כָּמַהּ), 4Ma.15:22 * ;] 
interrog., how large, how great ? (prop., of magnitude, as πόσος of quantity): in exclamations, = ἡλίκος (see Bl., § 51, 4), Galates 6:11; of personal greatness, Hébreux 7:4.†

G4081.def:
πηλός, οῦ, ἁ 
[in LXX chiefly for חֹמֶר, טִיט ] 
__1. clay, as used by a potter: Romains 9:21 (cf. Ésaïe 29:16, al.). 
__2. - βόρβορος, wet clay, mud: Jean 9:6, 11 9:14-15 †

G4082.def:
πἡρα, -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX: Jdth.10:5 13:10, 15 * ;] 
a leathern pouch for victuals, etc., a wallet (Deiss. thinks an alms-bag, see LAE, 108 ff.): Matthieu 10:10, Marc 6:8, Luc 9:3 10:4 22:35-36.†

G4083.def:
πῆχυς, -εως genitive pl., -ῶν (for Att.. -εων, see WH, App., 157; Thackeray, Gr., 151; Deiss., BS, 153), 
[in LXX chiefly and frequently for אַמָּה ;] 
__1. the forearm (Hom.). 
__2. As a measure of length, a cubit: Matthieu 6:27, Luc 12:25, Jean 21:8, Apocalypse 21:17.†

G4084.def:
πιάζω
(cf. MGr. πιάνω; see Kennedy, Sources, 155), Doric and late Att.. for πιέζω in its later senses [in LXX: Cantique des cantiques 2:15 (אָחַז), Sir.23:21 * ;] 
__1. to lay hold of: Actes 3:7 (Theocr.). 
__2. to take, capture, apprehend: Jean 7:30, 32 7:44 8:20 10:39 11:57 21:3, 10 Actes 12:4, 2 Corinthiens 11:32, Apocalypse 19:20 (see MM, xx).†

G4085.def:
πιέζω 
[in LXX : Michée 6:15 (דָּרַךְ)* ;] 
__1. to press, press down or to­gether: Luc 6:38 (cl). 
__2. Later, to seize (see: πιάζω).†

G4086.def:
πιθανολογία, -ας, ἡ 
(πιθανός, persuasive, plausible), 
in cl. (Plat), 
the use of probable arguments, as opposite to demonstration (ἀπόδειξις); hence, persuasive speech: Colossiens 2:4 (see ICC, in l).†

G4087.def:
πικραίνω
(πικρός), [in LXX for מָרַד, קָצַף, etc. ;] 
to make bitter: Apocalypse 10:9; pass., Apocalypse 8:11 10:10; metaphorically, to embitter (LXX) : pass., before πρός, Colossiens 3:19.†

G4089.def:
πικρός, -ά, -όν
(poët. in cl.), [in LXX chiefly for מַר ;] 
__1. sharp, pointed. 
__2. sharp to the senses; of taste, bitter: opposite to γλυκύ, Jacques 3:11; metaphorically, harsh, bitter: Jacques 3:14

G4090.def:
πικρῶς 
adv. (πικρός), [in LXX for מַר, מָרַר pi. ;] 
bitterly: metaphorically, (cf. πικρὸν δάκρυον, Hom.), ἔκλαυσε π., Matthieu 26:75, Luc 22:62 (see MM, xviii, see word παρακολουθέω).†

G4091.def:
Πειλᾶτος (Rec. Πιλάτος, Tr., -ᾶτος, see WH, App., 155), -ου, ὁ, 
Pontius Pilate: Matthieu 27:2, Marc 15:1, Luc 3:1, Jean 18:29, Actes 3:13, 1 Timothée 6:13, al

G4092.def:
πίμπρημι
(in cl. prose, rare in the simple form), [in LXX: Nombres 5:21-22, 27 (צָבֶה) * ;] 
__1. to blow, burn. 
__2. Later, to cause to swell; mid., of parts of the body, to become swollen (LXX) : Actes 28:6 (cf. ἐμπίπρημι).†

G4093.def:
πινακίδιον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of πινακίς, which see), [in Sm.: Eze.9:2 * ;] 
a writing tablet: Luc 1:63.†

G4095.def:
πίνω 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁתָה ;] 
to drink: absol., Luc 2:19, Jean 4:7, al.; with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 6:26, 31 Marc 14:25, al.; of habitual use, Luc 1:15, Romains 14:21, al.; by meton., τὸ ποτήριον, 1 Corinthiens 10:21, al.; of the earth absorbing rain (Hdt., al.), Hébreux 6:7; spiritually, of the blood of Christ, Jean 6:53-54, 56; before ἐκ (of the vessel), Matthieu 26:27, al.; id. (of the drink; Bl., § 36, 1), Matthieu 26:29, Jean 4:13-14 Apocalypse 14:10, al.; ἀπό, Luc 22:18 (cf. ἀπο-, συν-πίνω; on the form πίεσαι, Luc 17:8, see Bl., § 21, 8, and on the contr. aor. πεῖν, M, Pr., 44 f., Thackeray, Gr., 63 f.)

G4096.def:
πιότης, -ητος, ἡ
(πίων, fat), [in LXX chiefly for דֶּשֶׁן ;] 
fatness: Romains 11:17.†

G4097.def:
πιπράσκω 
[in LXX chiefly for מָכַר ni. ;] 
to sell: with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 13:46 (on this pf., see Bl., § 59, 5), Actes 2:45 4:34 5:4; with genitive (of price), Matthieu 26:9, Marc 14:5, Jean 12:5; with accusative of person(s) (of slavery), Matthieu 18:25; hence metaphorically, Romains 7:14 (cf. 4Ki.17:17, 1Ma.1:15, al.).†

G4098.def:
πίπτω 
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל ;] 
to fall; 
__1. of descent, to fall, fall down or from: before ἐπί, with accusative loc., Matthieu 10:29, al.; εἰς, Matthieu 15:14, al.; ἐς μέσῳ, with genitive, Luc 8:7; παρὰ τ. ὁδόν, Matthieu 13:4, Marc 4:4, Luc 8:5; before ἀπό, Matthieu 15:27, al.; ἐκ, Marc 13:25, Luc 10:18, Apocalypse 8:10 9:1. Metaphorical: ὁ ἥλιος, before ἐπί, Apocalypse 7:16; ἀχλὺς κ. σκότος, Actes 13:11; ὁ κλῆρος, Actes 1:26; ὑπὸ κρίσιν, Jacques 5:12. 
__2. Of prostration, 
__(a) of persons, to fall prostrate, prostrate oneself: χαμαί Jean 18:6; before ἐπί, with accusative, Matthieu 17:6, Actes 9:4; id. with genitive, Marc 9:20; πρὸς τ. πόδας, Actes 5:10, Apocalypse 1:17; πεσὼν ἐξέψυξε, Actes 5:5; of supplication, homage or worship: πρὸς (παρὰ, ἐπὶ) τ. πὸδας, Marc 5:22, Luc 8:41, Actes 10:25, al.; π. καὶ προσκυνεῖν, Apocalypse 5:14 19:4; ptcp. with προσκυνεῖν, Matthieu 2:11, al.; ἐνώπιον, Apocalypse 4:10 5:8; ἐπὶ πρόσωπον, Matthieu 26:39, al.; 
__(b) of things, to fall, fall down: Matthieu 21:44, Luc 23:30; of falling to ruin and destruction, Matthieu 7:25, Actes 15:16, Hébreux 11:30; ἔπεσε (timeless aorist; M, Pr.,134), Apocalypse 18:2. Metaphorical: Romains 11:11; πόθεν πέπτωκας, Apocalypse 2:5; opposite to ἑστόναι, 1 Corinthiens 10:12; to στήκειν, Romains 14:4; of virtues, 1 Corinthiens 13:8; of precepts, Luc 16:17. 
(cf. ἀνα-, ἀντι-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, παρα-, περι-, προσ-, συν-πίπτω.) 
συν-πίπτω (Rec. συμπ-), 
[in LXX for נָפַל, etc. ;] 
to fall together, fall in, etc.: of a house (cf. MM, xxiv), Luc 6:49.†

G4099.def:
Πισιδία, -ας, ι 
Pisidia, a region of Asia Minor: Actes 14:24
